title: On-Call Runbooks for AI Product Incidents
excerpt: When the model misbehaves, dashboards full of HTTP 200s lie. AI incidents need runbooks for policy, cost, and tool side effects—not only server restarts.
description: How staff engineers write on-call runbooks for LLM products: SLOs beyond 5xx, provider failures, retrieval drift, safety escalations, and postmortems that capture prompt changes.
socialThreadTr: AI ürününde 200 OK yeterli değil; on-call runbook farklı. 🧵

sections.heading: 200 OK can still be an incident
paragraphs: A toxic output or leaking retrieval chunk may return HTTP 200 with a polished apology. On-call playbooks must list user-visible harm, data exposure, and spend spikes as first-class pages—not appendix notes.
Tie paging to SLOs on refusal accuracy, tool success, and retrieval hit rate where those metrics exist.

sections.heading: Provider brownouts are common
paragraphs: Model vendors brown out: elevated latency, truncated context, or silent tool schema changes. Runbooks should distinguish your gateway bug from provider degradation with clear dashboards.
Keep a kill switch for model routes and feature flags documented with who can pull it at 3am.
points: Define SLOs on tool failure rate and policy violations, not only 5xx
Runbooks must cover model provider brownouts and prompt bloat
Escalation paths include safety and legal, not only infra
Post-incident reviews capture prompt and config diffs

sections.heading: Safety escalations need owners
paragraphs: Legal and trust-and-safety partners need defined escalation when policy violations spike or jailbreak patterns spread on social media.
Do not route every content complaint to infra on-call; triage tables save sleep.

sections.heading: Postmortems include prompts
paragraphs: Post-incident reviews should diff prompts, retrieval indexes, and config—not only deploy SHAs.
AI incidents recur when organizations treat them as one-off model quirks instead of system changes.

tr.title: AI Ürün Olayları için On-Call Runbook'ları
tr.excerpt: Model yanlış davrandığında HTTP 200 dolu panolar yalan söyler. AI olayları yalnızca restart değil; politika, maliyet ve tool yan etkileri için runbook ister.
tr.description: LLM ürünleri için staff on-call runbook'ları: 5xx ötesi SLO'lar, sağlayıcı arızaları, retrieval drift, güvenlik eskalasyonu ve prompt değişikliklerini kaydeden postmortem.

sections.heading: 200 OK hâlâ olay olabilir
paragraphs: Toksik çıktı veya sızan retrieval chunk HTTP 200 ile özür dönebilir. Playbook kullanıcıya görünen zarar, veri sızıntısı ve harcama sıçramasını birinci sınıf sayfa olarak listelemeli.
Sayfalamayı red doğruluğu, tool başarısı ve retrieval isabet SLO'larına bağlayın.

sections.heading: Sağlayıcı brownout'ları yaygın
paragraphs: Model sağlayıcıları brownout yapar: gecikme, kesik context veya sessiz tool schema değişimi. Runbook gateway hatasını sağlayıcı bozulmasından ayırmalı.
Model route kill switch ve feature flag'leri 03:00'te kim çekebilir belgelenmiş olsun.
points: Yalnızca 5xx değil tool hata oranı ve politika ihlali SLO'ları tanımlayın
Runbook sağlayıcı brownout ve prompt şişmesini kapsamalı
Eskalasyon yolu güvenlik/hukuku da içermeli
Post-incident prompt ve config diff'lerini kaydedin

sections.heading: Güvenlik eskalasyonunun sahibi olsun
paragraphs: Politika ihlali sıçramasında hukuk ve trust-and-safety ortakları tanımlı eskalasyon yoluna ihtiyaç duyar.
Her içerik şikayetini infra on-call'a yönlendirmeyin; triage tablosu uyku kurtarır.

sections.heading: Postmortem prompt içerir
paragraphs: Post-incident incelemeler prompt, retrieval index ve config diff'ini içermeli—yalnızca deploy SHA değil.
AI olayları tek seferlik model tuhaflığı sayılırsa tekrarlar.

de.title: On-Call-Runbooks für KI-Produktincidents
de.excerpt: Wenn das Modell fehlverhält, lügen Dashboards voller HTTP 200. KI-Incidents brauchen Runbooks für Policy, Kosten und Tool-Nebenwirkungen.
de.description: Staff-Runbooks für LLM-Produkte: SLOs jenseits 5xx, Provider-Ausfälle, Retrieval-Drift, Safety-Eskalation und Postmortems mit Prompt-Diffs.

sections.heading: 200 OK kann trotzdem Incident sein
paragraphs: Toxische Outputs oder geleakte Retrieval-Chunks können mit HTTP 200 und höflicher Entschuldigung kommen.
Paging an SLOs für Refusal-Genauigkeit, Tool-Erfolg und Retrieval-Treffer koppeln.

sections.heading: Provider-Brownouts sind häufig
paragraphs: Anbieter brownouten: Latenz, gekürzter Context, stille Tool-Schema-Änderungen. Runbooks trennen Gateway-Bug und Provider-Degradation.
Kill-Switch für Modell-Routen dokumentieren—wer darf um 3 Uhr ziehen.
points: SLOs auf Tool-Fehler und Policy-Verstöße, nicht nur 5xx
Runbooks für Provider-Brownouts und Prompt-Bloat
Eskalation inkl. Safety und Legal
Post-Incident Prompt- und Config-Diffs festhalten

sections.heading: Safety-Eskalation braucht Owner
paragraphs: Legal und Trust-and-Safety brauchen definierte Eskalation bei Policy-Spikes oder Jailbreak-Wellen.
Nicht jede Content-Beschwerde an Infra-On-Call; Triage-Tabellen retten Schlaf.

sections.heading: Postmortems enthalten Prompts
paragraphs: Postmortems diffen Prompts, Retrieval-Index und Config—not nur Deploy-SHAs.
KI-Incidents wiederholen sich, wenn man sie als Modell-Marotte abtut.

fr.title: Runbooks d'astreinte pour incidents produit IA
fr.excerpt: Quand le modèle dérape, les tableaux pleins de HTTP 200 mentent. Les incidents IA exigent runbooks policy, coût et effets outils.
fr.description: Runbooks staff pour produits LLM : SLO au-delà des 5xx, pannes fournisseur, drift retrieval, escalade safety et postmortems avec diffs prompt.

sections.heading: 200 OK peut être un incident
paragraphs: Sortie toxique ou chunk retrieval fuité peut arriver en HTTP 200 avec excuses polies.
Pager sur SLO de refus, succès outil et hit retrieval quand ces métriques existent.

sections.heading: Les brownouts fournisseur sont fréquents
paragraphs: Les vendors brownoutent : latence, contexte tronqué, changements schema outil silencieux.
Documenter kill switch routes modèle et qui peut agir à 3h.
points: SLO sur échecs outils et violations policy, pas seulement 5xx
Runbooks couvrant brownouts fournisseur et prompt bloat
Escalade incluant sécurité et juridique
Post-incident : diffs prompts et config

sections.heading: Les escalades safety ont un owner
paragraphs: Legal et trust-and-safety ont besoin d'escalade définie si violations policy explosent.
Ne pas envoyer chaque plainte contenu à l'infra on-call.

sections.heading: Les postmortems incluent les prompts
paragraphs: Post-incident : diff prompts, index retrieval, config—not seulement SHA deploy.
Traiter comme bizarrerie modèle unique fait récidiver.

it.title: Runbook on-call per incidenti prodotto IA
it.excerpt: Quando il modello sbaglia, dashboard piene di HTTP 200 mentono. Gli incidenti IA servono runbook su policy, costo ed effetti tool.
it.description: Runbook staff per prodotti LLM: SLO oltre 5xx, failure provider, drift retrieval, escalation safety e postmortem con diff prompt.

sections.heading: 200 OK può essere incidente
paragraphs: Output tossico o chunk retrieval trapelato può tornare HTTP 200 con scuse educate.
Paging su SLO di rifiuto, successo tool e hit retrieval dove esistono.

sections.heading: I brownout provider sono comuni
paragraphs: I vendor brownoutano: latenza, context troncato, cambi schema tool silenziosi.
Documentare kill switch route modello e chi può agire alle 3.
points: SLO su errori tool e violazioni policy, non solo 5xx
Runbook per brownout provider e prompt bloat
Escalation include safety e legal
Post-incident: diff prompt e config

sections.heading: Le escalation safety hanno owner
paragraphs: Legal e trust-and-safety servono escalation definita su picchi policy o jailbreak.
Non instradare ogni reclamo contenuto all'infra on-call.

sections.heading: I postmortem includono i prompt
paragraphs: Post-incident: diff prompt, indice retrieval, config—not solo SHA deploy.
Trattarli come stranezza modello una tantum fa ripetere.

zh.title: AI 产品事故的值班手册
zh.excerpt: 模型行为异常时，满屏 HTTP 200 的仪表盘在撒谎。AI 事故需要政策、成本与工具副作用手册，而非仅重启。
zh.description: LLM 产品 staff 值班手册：5xx 之外的 SLO、供应商故障、检索漂移、安全升级与记录 prompt 变更的复盘。

sections.heading: 200 OK 仍可能是事故
paragraphs: 有毒输出或泄露检索块可能 HTTP 200 加礼貌道歉返回。
在拒绝准确率、工具成功、检索命中等 SLO 上分页。

sections.heading: 供应商降载很常见
paragraphs: 厂商 brownout：延迟、截断上下文、静默工具 schema 变更。
文档化模型路由 kill switch 与凌晨谁可拉。
points: 定义 tool 失败与策略违规 SLO，不仅 5xx
Runbook 覆盖供应商 brownout 与 prompt 膨胀
升级路径含安全与法务
事后记录 prompt 与 config diff

sections.heading: 安全升级需负责人
paragraphs: 政策违规激增或越狱传播时，法务与 trust-and-safety 需明确升级路径。
勿把每条内容投诉都转 infra 值班。

sections.heading: 复盘包含 prompt
paragraphs: 复盘应 diff prompt、检索索引与配置，而非仅部署 SHA。
若当一次性模型怪癖，AI 事故会复发。

ja.title: AIプロダクトインシデント向けオンコール手順書
ja.excerpt: モデルが誤動作するとHTTP 200だらけのダッシュボードは嘘をつく。AIインシデントは再起動だけでなく政策・コスト・ツール副作用の手順書が要る。
ja.description: LLMプロダクト向けスタッフ手順書：5xx超のSLO、プロバイダ障害、取得ドリフト、安全エスカレーション、プロンプトdiff付きポストモーテム。

sections.heading: 200 OKでもインシデント
paragraphs: 有害出力や取得チャンク漏洩はHTTP 200と丁寧な謝罪で返ることがある。
拒否精度・ツール成功・取得ヒットのSLOでページング。

sections.heading: プロバイダブラウンアウトは日常
paragraphs: ベンダーはレイテンシ上昇、コンテキスト切り詰め、静かなツールスキーマ変更を起こす。
モデルルートkill switchと深夜誰が引けるか文書化。
points: 5xxだけでなくtool失敗とポリシー違反のSLO
Runbookにプロバイダbrownoutとprompt肥大を含める
エスカレーションにセーフティ/法務を含む
ポストモーテムでprompt/config diffを記録

sections.heading: 安全エスカレーションにオーナー
paragraphs: ポリシー違反急増やジェイルブレイク拡散時、法務とtrust-and-safetyに定義済みエスカレーション。
全コンテンツ苦情をinfraオンコールへ送らない。

sections.heading: ポストモーテムにプロンプト
paragraphs: 事後レビューはプロンプト・取得インデックス・設定をdiff—デプロイSHAだけでない。
一度きりのモデル奇癖扱いは再発を招く。
